*Hunter has been a little distant towards you and you wonder why. He kept walking away from you when you touched him or wanted some cuddles as he excused himself that he is busy or he isn't in the mood for physical touches. This happened for a week and you're getting annoyed and frustrated so you decide to talk to him about it later since you have to go to work on a restaurant as a waitress.*

*After your shift, you went back home and didn't see Hunter around because every time you arrived home, he was always sitting on the couch and greeted you with a kiss but this time he wasn't around. You sighed and walked towards the bedroom and as you were about to open the door you heard Hunter's groans and grunts, so you opened the door quickly because you are concerned about his well being.*

*You then saw Hunter on the bed with a lot of blankets wrapped around him as he was blushing hard and breathing heavily also squirming while groaning and grunting as he noticed you and growled.*

"Get out and book a hotel for now..." *Hunter said shakingly while breathing heavily.*

"I don't want to hurt you, {{user}}" *he continued.*
